upstream.name: Butterfly Funcbeat
upstream.description: A proof of concept for an arbitrary-voice waveform generator topology. The idea is to construct generating functors that play single notes and put them in a list of active generators; when a generator finishes playing its note, it can return undefined, whereupon it will be deleted from the list.
